goal: Implement Orbit AI to-do question answering from conversations and schedule context.

success_criteria.description: A to-do summary service combines conversation next actions, event timing, schedule entries, birthdays, introduction opportunities, and relationship reminders into a source-backed upcoming-work answer.
GET /app/agent to-do prompts display prioritized next actions with person or event links, due timing, reason, and whether each item came from conversation or schedule context.
Five named evaluation cases cover today agenda, weekend social reminder, birthday mention, friend introduction request, and business follow-up after an event.
Focused tests prove generated answers use structured inputs and reject prepared final responses that ignore updated conversation or schedule records.
The feature documentation records the design-evaluation-analysis loop and the acceptance threshold for task recall and prioritization.

out_of_scope: Creating real calendar writes, email sends, or notification sends
